title: 10. Oh No, I Had an Accident!
reviewMethod: English read-aloud translation compared with every original Korean page

pages.text: A new friend joined the Rainbow Class. It was Songi, a little deer. Today everyone was going on a trip to the park. Songi, come with us! Hori held out his hand.
Songi was shy. Even when the friends offered a warm welcome, Songi curled up small. Teacher Sheep gently held Songi's hand. You can get to know everyone slowly. I'll be right beside you.
While playing happily at the park, Songi began to need a pee. But the words, I need the bathroom, felt too embarrassing to say. Songi tried to hold it in.
Should I say it or not? Songi kept hesitating. It's embarrassing. I'll hold it a little longer. Songi twisted their legs together and pressed their toes close. But holding it was getting harder.
At last, Songi couldn't hold it anymore and had an accident. Those trousers grew wet, and a little puddle trickled onto the ground. Oh! Songi froze in place.
Songi's face turned bright red. Tears filled those eyes, and Songi looked down. Oh no, I'm so embarrassed. Songi wished nobody could see.
Teacher Sheep hurried over and gave Songi a big hug. It's okay. It's okay. Don't be afraid. The teacher's arms were warm, and Songi's trembling shoulders began to relax.
Hori came over and held Songi's hand. Songi, that happened to me when I was little, too! I was playing and forgot to go to the bathroom. Hori smiled. It's okay. It happened to me, too!
Bori nodded. Me, too. There's nothing to be embarrassed about. As the friends spoke kindly, a little smile spread across Songi's face. Really? I'm not the only one.

Songi changed into clean, dry clothes and smiled again. Teacher Sheep said, If you need the bathroom, you can tell me anytime. There's nothing embarrassing about it. It happened to me, too! Laughter bloomed in the Rainbow Class.
